:::{#exr-dim-subadditive-practice}
#### Finding the dimension of a sum of subspaces that meet only at the origin

@cor-dim-subadditive says when the [dimension](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) of a [sum](#def-subspace-sum)
matches the total of the dimensions.
Let $\mathcal{S}_1$ and $\mathcal{S}_2$ be [subspaces](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-subspace) of $\reals^5$
with $\dim(\mathcal{S}_1) = 2$, $\dim(\mathcal{S}_2) = 3$
and $\mathcal{S}_1 \cap \mathcal{S}_2 = \cb{\vzero}$,
so that they meet only at the origin.

Find $\dim(\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2)$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use the equality case of @cor-dim-subadditive.

:::

:::
